transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you’re here. What brings you in today?

Well, the main reason I decided to come in is... I just can't seem to stay at my desk. I work as an insurance claims clerk, and I keep getting up from my workstation during the day. I know I'm supposed to stay put and finish my claim reviews, but I just keep leaving my seat. It's becoming a real problem.
Did you have similar trouble staying seated or paying attention when you were a child?

Yeah, looking back... this really wasn't a brand new thing for me. I remember in elementary school, my teachers used to write notes saying that I was bright, but I constantly lost my worksheets. I'd miss out on instructions a lot, too, and they always had to give me reminders just to finish my regular classwork. So the trouble paying attention has definitely been there for a while.
Do you have these attention problems outside of work as well, like at home or in other parts of your life?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really noticed it being a big issue at home. It seems like it's mostly just at work where it really stands out. When I'm off the clock, I don't really have the same kind of strict tasks to get through, so... yeah, I haven't really noticed it outside of my job.
Do these concentration or distraction problems happen in more than one setting, such as at home, too?
Like I was just saying, not really. I haven't noticed it being a problem at home or anywhere else. It really just seems to be an issue at the office when I'm trying to get through my work.
Do you have these attention or distraction problems in any other settings besides work, such as at home or in social situations?

Um, I think I just answered that, but no. Like I was saying, it's really just at the office. Processing insurance claims all day is where I get distracted and hit a wall. When I'm at home, or out with friends... no, I haven't noticed any issues. It's pretty much just a work thing as far as I can tell.
